search_window.basis: Overlapping conservative window beginning at latest independently retrieved prior verified heartbeat completion (02:48:09 PST); a later 03:xx heartbeat could not be listed using the available GitHub file connector. This wider-than-hourly start ensures the preceding hour is not missed. Target only newly occurring/reported disruptions, not older results merely recrawled.

coverage_notes.purpose: Bounded supplementary recall only; production nationwide collector remains authoritative.
classes_checked: Loss/closure/fire/disaster affecting sole, only, last, or full-service community grocery
Emergency food distributions canceled/suspended due to storm/flood/fire/outage/facility damage
Abrupt food pantry or food bank service closure or major access reduction
New official SNAP/WIC/food assistance interruption with immediate access consequences

coverage_notes.observation: All 12 targeted web searches returned usable search results, but none verified a new, in-window high-value food-access disruption. Results largely concerned previously reported incidents, general storm recovery information, routine distribution schedules, irrelevant power outages, and older benefits-shutdown notices.

coverage_notes.limitations: GitHub connector did not provide directory listing of newer heartbeats, so latest prior run could not be positively established; conservative overlap from last verified prior completion used. Search indexing may lag first-party local notices, and negative findings are not exhaustive.
